name: @immunity-wars/ui
comment:dependencies: content, and deliberately NOT engine. The ui-app-no-engine boundary rule permits content and forbids engine; the ui-app-no-unresolvable rule beside it makes an UNRESOLVED import red, which means a permitted import that does not resolve is red too. So this dependency is what makes 'ui may import content' true rather than merely written down. Do not add @immunity-wars/engine here: the gate will catch it, which is the point.
